messages:
incident-bot: Paging: prefix-cache hitrate drop >30% in us-east-1. Error spike seen on /generate endpoints. Severity: P2. Escalate to on-call.
eli: seeing very large eviction counts across kv-shard-12 and kv-shard-13, started ~2026-03-14T16:04:50Z. Customer-impact: increased 502s for realtime customers (app-prod-us-east). We'll need a mitigation ASAP.
maya: on it — joining. Eli can you paste the earliest logs + quick metric snapshot? Also anyone with RBAC to bump cache size?
eli: quick timeline I pulled from logs:
- 16:04:49Z: small deploy to routing service (canary)
- 16:05:12Z: sharp increase in `evict` events on kv-shard-12
- 16:05:40Z: prefix cache miss rate jumps from 3% -> 48%
- 16:06:05Z: first customer 502s reported by healthcheck (app-prod-us-east)
- 16:08:30Z: autoscaling triggered on serving pool, but latency remains elevated

eli: snippets from kv logs (sanitized):
```
[16:05:12] evict: shard=kv-12 key=prefix:/user/reprompt:123 size=72 reason=mem_pressure
[16:05:12] evict: shard=kv-12 key=prefix:/user/session:89 size=128 reason=mem_pressure
[16:05:13] miss: shard=kv-12 key=prefix:/user/reprompt:123 prev_hit=0
[16:05:13] evict-stats: shard=kv-12 free=120MB used=980MB limit=1GB
```

maya: hypothesis 1: a miscalculated cache limit after routing canary caused early evictions — perhaps the canary changed seq_len distribution and increased high-cardinality prefixes. Hypothesis 2: a background reindex job hit right when canary started and bumped memory.
maya: mitigation plan (live):
- step1: temporarily raise kv-shard eviction threshold on kv-12 and kv-13 to 0.9 (reduce evictions)
- step2: enable aggressive prefix-protection for hot prefixes (pin top 50)
- step3: route new requests to fallback model-compact for critical customers

sasha: I'll take config change for step1. Doing `shardctl set-evict-threshold kv-12 0.9` now.
sasha: applied to kv-12 and kv-13. confirming metrics...
sasha: dashboard shows miss rate falling from 48% -> 22% over 90s. latency improving. :thumbsup:
eli: I'm sharing grep of deploy logs — looks like the canary touched a routing table update that increased shard affinity for many user prefixes:
```
2026-03-14T16:04:45Z INFO routing: update assignment load_factor=1.15 impacted_prefixes=~12k
```

jun: reindex job logs show a single heavy job started at 16:05:00Z on infra-reindexer-3. It scanned ~2M keys.
jun: patch to reindexer scheduled but not yet rolled back. I'm pausing the job.
jun: paused reindexer-3; infra team will investigate overlap w/canary.
maya: customer impact note: affected ~6 customers in us-east with elevated tail-latency and occasional 502s between 16:05-16:12. We've contacted SRE-CS for outreach.
eli: gathering full set of logs (kv, routing, deploy) and will drop into shared drive: https://drive.redwood/incident-2153467890/logs
sasha: handing over to sasha (next oncall) for live mitigation monitoring — I'll stay available for config rollback if needed. @sasha this will be your handoff at 16:12Z.
sasha: acknowledged, taking over monitoring. plan summary: keep evict-threshold=0.9, pin hot prefixes for 30m, watch missrate and customer errors. If missrate <10% and errors stable -> start safe rollback of threshold after 30m.
maya: capture evidence: please keep the `evict` log tail and `prefix-hit` metric series, add query IDs for affected requests. We'll build timeline for RCA.
eli: copying sample request ids and traces to the drive. Also export kibana query: `service:kv AND evict AND shard:kv-12 AND @timestamp:[2026-03-14T16:04:30 TO 2026-03-14T16:10:00]`
sasha: adding a quick note to the incident channel and tagging product for rollback approval.
incident-bot: Action logged: mitigation-config-change by sasha at 2026-03-14T16:12:10Z. Incident status: mitigation in progress.
maya: next steps for RCA thread: collect (1) full deploy diff, (2) reindex job schedule and config, (3) shard memory/evict metrics, (4) top 100 evicted prefixes. We should also run prefix-hitrate replay against canary routing config.
eli: initial artifact links in drive. I'll assemble timeline and fill gaps. Marking this thread as active handoff -> please continue updates here. :lock:
sasha: noted. I'll post a 30m status and then a 1h follow-up. If anything regresses I'll re-escalate.
